title: Dark mode and 1024 px: negative Inventory Value figures in parentheses read correctly
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Reports View. Data: QAPL-N1 (+5/-2), QAPL-N2 (-2 only), QAPL-N5 (+3/+2/-9994) at Staging Heavy Duty. Theme: profile menu > Dark. Window 1440 px, then 1024 px.
custom_steps:
1. Profile menu > Dark. Reports > Inventory Value (/reports/inventory-value): Staging Heavy Duty, As-of today > Run > sort Qty ascending.
  2. Read the totals row (row_iv_totals).
  3. Resize the window to 1024 px.
  4. Profile menu > Light, still at 1024 px.
custom_expected:
1. The negative rows (QAPL-N5, QAPL-N2) come first; their Qty and Total Cost in parentheses and their "—" Margin % are legible on the dark background.
  2. The totals row is legible; any negative total shows its parentheses in full.
  3. Every column fits; no parentheses, "—" or totals-row figure is clipped or cut off.
  4. The same figures read correctly in light mode; layout unchanged.
